scheme_name: Health and Maternity Cover for the Construction Workers
state: U.T. Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Must have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Benefits are limited to the first two children of the applicant
Applicant must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the UT
benefits_summary: Provides cash assistance of ₹30,000 for male workers and ₹40,000 for female workers per delivery (limited to the first two children), and enrolls beneficiaries under PM-JAY (Ayushman Bharat).
